meta.notes: Extracted from menu_0..5.tpf.dcx (DS1 Remastered). Position = (x,y) top-left of a 164x184 cell in the named sheet. Keyed by decimal param row id (same id space as items.json's hex 'Id' field, parsed as int). 87 goods rows had an icon id outside the mapped 2-sheet range and are omitted (likely unused/placeholder rows reusing a magic-icon id, not real inventory goods). Magic (sorceries/pyromancies/miracles) icons live on Icon30 (base GoodIcon id 3000, same 164x184 grid); they are EquipParamGoods rows too (type nibble 4) so they share the goods table above, keyed the same way. 15 unnamed EquipParamGoods rows (ids 9000-9014, GoodIcon 7000-7014) were found and skipped as debug/placeholder, matching the policy already used for the rest of this file.
